name: Reticule
description: A reticule: a net of openings with the mesh left just wide enough to hold.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 8.0%, 8.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 92.0%, 92.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 8.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 8.0%, 8.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 92.0%, 92.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 8.0%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 42%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
